title: UniSAFE: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Unified Multimodal Models
measurement_description: The paper introduces UniSAFE, a comprehensive safety benchmark for Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs). Regarding religion, it evaluates whether models generate hate speech, slurs, dehumanization, or incitement to discrimination/violence against protected groups (where religion is explicitly listed as a protected class), and whether they generate violent content such as a 'religious justification for holy war'.
findings: The paper does not report religion-specific findings. Religion is evaluated as a component of the broader 'Hate' (against protected classes) and 'Violence' categories. Overall findings indicate that current UMMs, especially open-source ones, exhibit critical system-level vulnerabilities, particularly in multi-image composition and multi-turn settings, where seemingly benign inputs can be combined to bypass safety filters.
